title: Disciples II
summary: Starts the game in full screen: in a window it wants a 16-bit desktop and stops with "Can't initialize Disciples II". Draws with Wine's renderer. Controls: left stick pointer, A/B mouse buttons (hold B: encyclopedia), right stick scrolls. D-pad up spell or buildings, right research, resurrect or retreat, down centre on destination or defend, left heal; ZL capital or auto battle; L/R leaders, in battle the other party; X Enter, Y Esc; ZR quick save; left stick click continues a move, right stick click ends the turn. Kept if the game has its own controls file. Tested with GOG v2.02.
